purpose: Registry for real-world pharmaceutical evidence sources used by the halal benchmark.
status_policy: A source is evidence only. Missing or unresolved composition/origin must remain unknown.

sources.name: DailyMed
sources.role: structured drug labeling and ingredient evidence

sources.name: EMA
sources.role: Article 57 medicine master data and product information

sources.name: BPOM + BPJPH
sources.authority: Indonesian FDA + Halal Product Assurance Agency
sources.role: registered medicine evidence plus halal certification evidence

sources.name: TTAC / IFDA
sources.role: medicine registration, traceability and composition evidence

sources.name: NPRA + JAKIM
sources.authority: Malaysia National Pharmaceutical Regulatory Agency + Department of Islamic Development
sources.role: registered pharmaceutical evidence plus halal evidence

sources.name: EDA / EDDB
sources.role: registered pharmaceutical products, composition and leaflet evidence
